thread:
ana: Heads-up — planning to merge docs PR #456 tonight during the low-traffic window (00:30 UTC). Need quick sanity checks on the Netlify preview + the link-check job before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456

mike: I can run the link-check locally. Which command do you want me to use?

ana: Use the link-check script in the repo. Locally:```pnpm install && pnpm docs:check-links``` or if you use yarn:```yarn && yarn docs:linkcheck```

jessica: Netlify preview is failing right now — build 5abcde error shows: "Asset not found: /assets/sdk-snippet.js". Screenshot pasted in PR.

netlify-bot: Deploy report — site: redwood-docs, deploy id: 5abcde, status: failed, logs: npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE

samir: Looks like the asset path got rewritten by the webpack/static copy step. I can push a tiny fix to the branch in ~10–15m (will change the reference to `docs/static/js/sdk-snippet.js`). Alternatively we have a Vercel preview up: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/5678 if we need a quick check.

mike: If you push the patch, I'll re-run link-check locally. Also be aware link-check found one external redirect (old blog -> new blog) which the job flags as failure by default.

ana: Preference: don't merge without a working deploy-preview. If Samir's fix is quick, I'll wait until 01:00 UTC; otherwise we'll reschedule to tomorrow morning.

samir: Pushed fix in the branch: changed path and added a sanity check to the copy step. Triggering Netlify rebuild via the webhook.

netlify-bot: Deploy started — build 5abcd1 — triggered by user samir

jessica: Re-checking the PR preview... I still see one console warning but asset loads now, snippets render.

netlify-bot: Deploy succeeded — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-456--redwood-docs.netlify.app (build 5abcd1)

mike: Ran `pnpm docs:check-links` locally — all links green after the asset path fix and the redirect was allowed. Can someone with write-permissions retrigger CI on GitHub Actions (link-check + build)?

ana: @jessica can you give an approval after you eyeball the preview? @mike please don't merge until both approvals + CI are green. Moving target merge window to 01:15 UTC given the delay.

jessica: Verified preview and snippet rendering, leaving an approval now. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: CI summary for PR #456 — link-check: passed, build: passed, deploy-preview: succeeded

mike: CI green, I'm set to merge at 01:20 UTC unless anyone objects.

samir: No objections from me, :thumbsup:

ana: Thanks all. I'll note a follow-up issue to tighten the static asset pipeline and add a smoke test for the SDK snippet paths so this doesn't hit us again. If anything goes wrong after the merge we will revert. Closing this thread once merged.

mike: Merged at 01:22 UTC. Thanks everyone.

jessica: Thanks — will monitor the docs alert channel for any regressions.
